scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm -r --filter './examples/**' build && pnpm -r --filter './benchmarks/**' build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p lume-wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lume_wasm.wasm examples/triangle/public/lume_core.wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lume_wasm.wasm examples/cube/public/lume_core.wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lume_wasm.wasm benchmarks/renderer/public/lume_core.wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/lume_wasm.wasm benchmarks/comparison/public/lume_core.wasm
scripts.check: cargo test --workspace && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm -r --filter './examples/**' typecheck && pnpm -r --filter './benchmarks/**' typecheck
